notes.title: Edgar's Poetical Nightmare 2.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
-Fixed a lockup that could occour on Level 2 when passing the chest at the end of the level
-Fixed a lockup that could occour when loading Level 5.
-Fixed spikes under cogs on level 1 not doing any damage hence allowing the player to get stuck.
-Removed load button if the game hasn't been saved yet, preventing a potential crash.

notes.title: Edgar's Poetical Nightmare 2.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
[b]This is an important patch for Edgar's Poetical Nightmare that fixes issues in the game.[/b]
-Fixed inverted keyboard controls
-Fixed crash when starting level 3
-Added pipe above spike pit making it easier to hit switch on level 1
-Added spikes below cogs preventing getting stuck and dying instead.
-Edgar now has faster movement speed than before making certain puzzles easier.
-Fixed a race condition that could cause a crash when loading save games.
-Fixed a bug that would not load game and return to main menu.
-Switch to C++ for optimized performance on Windows.

notes.title: Edgar's Poetical Nightmare 2.0
notes.notes:
-This updated edition for Steam, Nintendo Switch and XBOX overhauls the game significantly since it's initial release. More specifically, these are the changes.
-Fixed multiple crash issues when changing levels
-Fixed all bugs reported since release.
-Added full controller support instead of being locked to keyboard and mouse.
-Fixed performance issues
-Fixed control bugs.
-Fixed certain impassable areas in levels.
-Full support for SteamOS / Steam Deck.

notes.title: Edgar is now a full release
notes.notes: [b]A 'poe', steampunk inspired platformer and hack n slash with a poetic story and challenging platforming and stragety based levels with a unique Ghost Phase shift ability! Featuring retro arcade graphics and charming details, this will keep you entertained for hours. [/b]

notes.title: Updated Level Editor Project
notes.notes: We've updated the level editor project from Early Access to final.

notes.title: Release version
notes.notes: Thanks to all our players of Edgar, we are happy to release the 1.0 version, which ends Early Access. It's been an exciting journey getting the game off the ground and there are even more exciting updates coming soon!
